name: Ip2_CpmMat_CpmMat_CpmPhys
description: Convert 2 CpmMat instances to CpmPhys with corresponding parameters. Uses simple (arithmetic) averages if material are different. Simple copy of parameters is performed if the material<CpmMat> is shared between both particles. See cpm-model<CpmMat> for detals.

attributes.name: cohesiveThresholdIter
attributes.description: Should new contacts be cohesive? They will before this iter#, they will not be afterwards. If 0, they will never be. If negative, they will always be created as cohesive (10 by default).

attributes.name: E
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute interaction's normal modulus. If None, average value is used.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
